name.description: The name of the {@link Microservice.Iface} to deploy.

envName.description: The name of the {@link Microservice} {@link Env} to deploy.

appName.description: The name of the {@link Microservice} {@link App} to deploy.

appMode.description: The mode in which to deploy the {@link Microservice} {@link App}.

rootPkg.description: The name of the {@link Microservice} {@link Pkg} to deploy.

waitTimeMillis.description: The max amount of time to wait for the {@link #envName} or {@link #appName} to start.

serverVersion.description: The version of the server to use when starting the {@link Microservice} {@link App}.

taskNodeCount.description: The number of task nodes the {@link Microservice} needs to function.

configureType.description:
The optional {@link Type#name} passed to {@link #configure}.
If not present, {@link #configure} will not be called.

configureAction.description:
The optional action passed to {@link #configure}.
If not present, {@link #configure} will not be called.

configureArgs.description: The optional argument array passed to {@link #configure}.

configureKwargs.description: The optional keyword argument map passed to {@link #configure}.

title: A specification describing how to deploy a {@link Microservice}.
name: Microservice.Deployment
